
```{python}
#| echo: false

import json
from pathlib import Path

# =========================================================
# Rutas
# =========================================================
main_path = Path.cwd().resolve()
folder_ptal = main_path / "Data" / "Data Ptal"

# =========================================================
# Obtener archivos GeoJSON
# =========================================================
archivos = sorted(
    [f.name for f in folder_ptal.glob("*.geojson")]
)

# =========================================================
# Crear index.json
# =========================================================
with open(folder_ptal / "index.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(
        archivos,
        f,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=4
    )

```

```{=html}
<iframe 
  id="ptal"
  class="map-ptal-bloque"
  src="Html/ptal_viewer/map_ptal.html"
  style="border: none;">
</iframe>

<script>
const iframeptal = document.getElementById("ptal");

iframeptal.addEventListener("load", () => {
  const baseURL = new URL(".", window.location.href);

  iframeptal.contentWindow.postMessage({
    areas: {
      "Baja conectividad": new URL(
        "Data/Area Baja/area_seleccionada.json",
        baseURL
      ).href,

      "Intermedia conectividad": new URL(
        "Data/Area Intermedia/area_seleccionada.json",
        baseURL
      ).href,

      "Alta conectividad": new URL(
        "Data/Area Alta/area_seleccionada.json",
        baseURL
      ).href
    }
  }, "*");
});
</script>
```
